title: 第784章 没有任何衰败的意思第783章 三千神魔
slug: 别人听劝仿明星你开局扮神明
content_zh:
，，！
所以，此刻周天星斗大阵凝聚出的那道人影一直在隐忍。
他没有选择立刻出手，而是在等待，想要在此等到那一滴血由盛转衰。
等到它将一切全部耗尽的时候。
到那个时候、在那个地方，再尽情出手，碾压对方。
可惜，周天星斗大阵凝聚出的这道人影又有些失算了。
那一位存在没有任何衰败的意思。
一片又一片光芒，全都旋绕在四周。
他一直没能等到如愿的时刻。
这种攻击太强悍了，无法再这样耗下去。
咚。
苍天都在坠落。
一片又一片流光在此升腾起来，化作了传说中的意象。
九层古老的小塔坠落下来，就这样撞击在周天星斗大阵凝聚出的那道人影的后背上。
直接让他在此大口咳血。
毫无疑问，这一击实在太过于沉重了。
比整片山脉砸落下来都要沉重。
无数流光落下，全部砸向周天星斗大阵凝聚出的那道人影。
雷光震撼。
他的骨骼嘎吱作响，仿佛被一片大地镇压了一般。

这种攻击如此恐怖，就这样从后方毫无徵兆地杀来，绝世无匹。
咚。
不仅仅是一座小塔。
高空之上，万物古老本源的气息垂落下来。
如同瀑布一般，好似天河倒挂，就这样倾泻在周天星斗大阵凝聚出的这道人影身上。
伴随着古老大道的镇压，伴随着规则气息的束缚，没有任何留手地全部冲了过去。
周天星斗大阵凝聚出的那道人影，身体在剧烈摇动、剧烈晃动。
仿佛无法抵抗了，仿佛支撑不住了。
他发出一声惨叫，在那里再次咳出一口血来。
周天星斗大阵凝聚出的那道人影看到这一切，眼神格外冷漠。
他的右手死死抓着黄金长枪，继而身体猛烈一震。
轰隆一声，他在这里挺直了自己的腰杆。
直接将古老的万物本源气息以及那口大鼎击退。
content_en:
,,!
Therefore, at this moment, the figure condensed by the Zhoutian Xingdou Formation has been holding back.
He did not choose to take action immediately, but was waiting, wanting to wait until that drop of blood changed from prosperity to decline.
Wait until it's all gone.
At that time and in that place, take action as much as you want to crush the opponent.
It's a pity that the figure condensed by the Zhoutian Xingdou Formation was a bit miscalculated again.
There is no decay in that One being.
Pieces of light after another, all swirling around.
He never got the moment he wanted.
This attack is too powerful and cannot be used up like this.
Boom.
The sky is falling.
Pieces of light rose up here one after another, turning into legendary images.
The nine-story ancient small tower fell down and hit the back of the figure condensed by the Zhoutian Star Array.
Just let him cough up blood.
There is no doubt that this blow is too heavy.
It is heavier than the entire mountain falling.
Countless streams of light fell, all of them hitting the figure condensed by Zhoutian's star formation.
Thunder shocks.
His bones creaked, as if they were being suppressed by a piece of earth.
This kind of attack is so terrifying, coming from behind without any warning, it is unparalleled.
Boom.
Not just a little tower.
High in the sky, the breath of the ancient origin of all things falls down.
Like a waterfall, like the Milky Way hanging upside down, it pours on the figure condensed by the star formation in the sky.
With the suppression of the ancient avenue and the restraint of the rules, they all rushed forward without holding back.
The body of the figure condensed in the Zhoutian Starry Formation was shaking violently.
It seemed that I couldn't resist, as if I couldn't hold on.
He let out a scream and coughed up another mouthful of blood.
Seeing all this, the figure condensed from the Zhou Tianxing Dou Formation looked extremely cold.
His right hand firmly grasped the golden spear, and then his body shook violently.
With a bang, he straightened his back here.
Directly repel the ancient aura of the origin of all things and the great cauldron.
